articleTitle: Design and Development of A Low-Cost Home Smart Light System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: To know the low-cost smart lighting system, we use a smart embedded system controller to control the lights using a portable receiver and can also determine which lamp LIGHT is unnecessarily and SWITCH off lights. We offer both fixed switches and sensor controls to optimize power and lessen user stress to control the switches. The life span of the bulbs increases normally, and the total cost of the electricity bill is also reduced. Because one always stops for a while. This is a modified application we have created to control The lights using a mobile phone. Automation plays an increasingly important role in the world economy and in daily experience. Automatic systems are being preferred over manual system. The research work shows automatic control of streetlights because of which power is saved to an extent. The Smart streetlight provides a solution for energy saving which is achieved by sensing an approaching vehicle using the IR sensors and then switching ON a block of streetlights ahead of the vehicle. As the vehicle passes by, the trailing lights switch OFF automatically. Thus, we save a lot of energy. So, when there are no vehicles on the highway, then all the lights remain OFF.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Agri-Bot for Ploughing, Seeding and Watering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In Indian economy, Agriculture is considered to be one of the most important sectors. It gives about 16% of total gross domestic product and 10%of the total exports. In spite of such significate contributions, it continued to be the least technologically and productively underdeveloped sector of India. For productive farming, new automation technologies need to be introduced into agriculture. In this, we develop a Agri-bot prototype which helps the user in ploughing, seeding and watering. It is an autonomous bot which is triggered only when placed on the field having certain (say threshold of 50) moisture content of soil and it is programmed to stop at certain interval to do the operations like ploughing, seeding and watering. If any obstacle is detected on its way, then it avoids and takes a turn. Further this prototype can be advanced by integrating GSM module such that it provides the current data of the Agri-bot to the remote user.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is one of the side effects of diabetes. Before the complaint progresses far enough, it largely goes undiagnosed. Because of this, precluding vision loss requires early discovery. This problem can be answered only by continuously covering the glucose position and early discovery of complaint and its timely treatment. Anon-invasive glucose monitoring system has been enforced for the observation of glucose position trends. A deep literacy model to speed up complaint discovery is presented in this paper. The Kaggle Diabetic Retinopathy Detection database was used to examine a dataset made up of thousands of fundus photographs of the retina taken under various imaging settings. After testing and retraining the model will be used to develop the system that have a stoner-friendly hindrance. This provides an automated system that will help ophthalmologists to grade the fundus images as No DR, Mild, Moderate, Severe and Proliferative DR. A system that can efficiently train a deep neural network for semantic segmentation of fundus pictures has been proposed as a prognosis of Microaneurysm and early opinion system for non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy. This system can boost the efficacy and delicacy.

articleTitle: Hygiene Rating System Using AWS
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The term ‘Hygiene’ particularly means a way of practicing and maintaining good health and preventing any disease through food, water, etc. In particular locations where food and beverages are served, inadequate hygiene procedures have the potential to lead to food poisoning and other food-borne illnesses. The main ideology of this particular research is public openness in knowing whether a place is hygienic or not. COVID-19 has put the public in a skeptical situation and the general public has now become well aware of cleanliness. They also expect to know how well maintained a place is without questioning the same. Our proposed model gives the public an open review about the safety of the restaurant. This model is based and built on the AWS cloud platform where the machine learning model shows the number of people who are following restaurant etiquette and safety measures. It uses the images as dataset with custom labels and the model is trained for accurate outputs based on the condition if a food handler is wearing a mask, gloves, and other appropriate kitchen safety equipment, and updates the tracker with the same.

articleTitle: Iot Based School Bus Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Ensuring the safety of students is a top priority, the proposed smart school bus monitoring system aims to assist parents and school administrators by managing and monitoring various aspects of transportation. By using Arduino, RFID, GPS, and GSM technologies, the system offers a comprehensive solution for tracking students on a school bus. An Android application enables parents to monitor their child's pickup and drop timings as well as the school bus's location, while the database unit updates the location with geographic coordinates. Additionally, the RFID scanner detects the student's identification when boarding the bus, system incorporates two switch buttons, one for notifying bus arrival and the other for emergencies that may arise during the route, the school unit manages and adds student information to the Android application created. The implementation of this system ensures student safety during transportation, and the monitoring appliance also provides management with updates on emergencies or complaints.

articleTitle: Smart Medicine Box Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The current trend in medical care is for routine clinical exams and other medical care administrations to be moved from the emergency room to the patient's home. This paper proposes a cutting-edge medical care IoT stage with a smart medication box and sensors for health monitoring and conclusion. Patients and specialists can communicate more effectively thanks to a sophisticated locally located medication box with remote availability and an Android application. The proposed device includes a smart medication box that sends out alerts to patients when their prescription is about to expire at just the right time. It is linked to the internet in order to provide patients with simple medication updates via an Android application. The framework routinely signals affected person to take the medicine at the best time. SMS warnings are issued.

articleTitle: Minimization of Transmit Power Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: At first, wireless power transfer (WPT) was focused on sending power over long distances and for high-power uses. However, their continued development has been constrained by the lower possible gearbox efficiency and potential health risks brought on by high power applications. Alternative Wireless Information and Power transmission techniques have proven critical not only for theoretical study but also for operational cost savings and the sustainable expansion of wireless communications due to the enormous energy consumption growth with ever-increasing linked devices. brand-new paradigm Energy Harvesting for wireless communication networks enables terminals to refuel their batteries with outside energy from the environment. However, selecting an energy harvesting technique plays a vital role in enhancing the benefits. In this paper, a SWIPT technique using channel polarization is proposed. Simulation results proved a major improvement in the proposed system in terms of power minimization.

articleTitle: Surveillance Amphibian All Terrain Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This project presents details of a robot that can navigate in rough terrain, ascend and descend on elevated surfaces as well as sloping surfaces and cross ditches. The robot is made up offour differentially steered wheels (4WD) and some passive mechanisms, making it suitable to cross ditches and landscape undulation. It can also be considered as an amphibian robot, as it can steer through the land surface as well as water surface. The robot comes equipped with an action camera which also supports night vision due to IR application. A GPS module is used to provide accurate coordinates of the area where movements are detected. An additional feature is installed in the robot which is an arduino controlled launcher system, the launcher system can be used during combat operations and will help the robot attain self defense ability.

articleTitle: Automation of Hydroponics Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In modern day agriculture, high yielding and high grade of the crops are essential, and this can be achieved by smart farming technology which is used for making farms more intelligent in sensing its controlling parameters. The main fiddling task was monitoring the plants manually which was in enactment because the plants may die out if proper care is not taken. The architecture of hydroponic systems is fully automatic that can be integrated into agricultural curriculum while introducing business skills. Hydroponic systems is nothing but growing plants in water without soil with the aid of extended nourishing solution. The automatic monitoring and control of the environmental events such as light intensity, pH, moisture level of the plant, surrounding temperature and the relative humidity is carried out by loading sensors and actuators onto the system. Basically, hydroponic system requires temperature range between 18°-26°C (60-85°F). The maintenance and automatic monitoring are done by the intervention of the IOT that are used to transfer and retrieve the data to internet(mass storage) and a mobile application is used to communicate the current status of the hydroponic system to the user through the use of internet to their mobile phones.

articleTitle: Enhancing 5G Connectivity: MIMO Antenna Design and Specific Absorption Rate Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to 5G antenna design, focusing on an inverted-L MIMO antenna. The design operates at 5.84GHz and optimizes parameters like reflection coefficient, gain, and voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR). The measured bandwidth spans 3.07GHz to 6.6GHz. All simulations and design work were conducted using the CST Microwave Studio Software, ensuring a user-friendly and practical approach to 5G antenna innovation.“

articleTitle: High Gain Planar Monopole Antenna Having Ultra Wideband Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: A compact planar monopole antenna having its application in ultrawideband (UWB) presented and discussed. The radiating patch is composed of a square shaped patch modified to have cascading rectangular notches along with two oblong coupling strips at either side of the feedline with a unique ground structure. The antenna occupies a 31(1)*25(w)*1.6(h) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, with a quite simple structure. The antenna radiates omnidirectional with different directivities within UWB spectrum and has an operational range of 3.1 to 9.1 GHz. The antenna design parameters like reflection coefficient, gain, and radiation pattern are measured and are found to be in harmony with the simulated results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Solar Panel Cleaning System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Solar panel cleaning system has become popular due to the rise in renewable form of energy. A lot of PV panels are used in modern world. Now that they are gaining popularity so does their facility. There are lot of benefits when we consider this form of energy, but in terms of efficiency there seems to be issues, one of them is dust formation over the panel which causes the panel to become inefficient. The proposed system is intended to implement a cleaning system that does not require any form of human intervention. A system which cleans based-on time schedule and a PIR sensor for analyses of dust to initiate panel cleaning.

articleTitle: Design of a Coplanar Waveguide Fed Dielectric Resonator Based Planar Monopole Antenna with Ultra-Wideband Characteristics and Having Circularly Polarized Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The design of a coplanar waveguide-fed (CPW-fed) planar monopole antenna with ultra-wideband characteristics and having circularly polarized radiation is proposed. The antenna consists of a very simple oblong radiator monopole, an inverted L-form strip, a horizontal stub at left of CPW ground plane, and a modified asymmetric ground plane. Simulation results indicate that the impedance bandwidth (IBW) is 107<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> (2.405-8.014 GHz), and the axial ratio bandwidth (ARBW) is 193% (0.054-3.290 GHz). The parametric study is performed for confirmation. Results specify that the designed antenna is acceptable for different wireless communication system

articleTitle: Autonomous Drone for Surveying Flooded Area and Performing Optimal Rescue Operation Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: During life threatening conditions caused due to natural disasters, search and rescue operations manually has not been possible to implement quickly. To overcome this issue, the proposed methodology provides a solution of using an autonomous drone with the help of image processing techniques in flooded scenarios. When any victims are identified, our proposed system aids in the rescue operations by visually screening the flooded areas and sending a signal to the rescue team. Using this UAV camera several image processing algorithms are performed to detect survivors to approximate the area of the flooded region.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IOT Enabled Smart Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Smart energy meters plays a key role in successful implementation smart grid. Smart meters effectively monitor and controls the power consumption which enables both consumers and system operators to participate in demand response. This paper proposes the design of IOT enabled smart energy meter which has a wider advantage than the traditional meter and can give the real time data about the power, units consumed, current, voltage frequency, power factor, fault status etc. and send it to the user through IOT, so that the user can also monitor and store the real time data in cloud platform, and the bill is generated by DISCOM's without visiting to the individual's home.

articleTitle: Medicine Vending Machine Using RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In order to pursue a healthy future, development must include access to basic healthcare. The role that medicines play in human life is crucial. Among the inventions are pharmaceutical currency machines with RFID capabilities. Our approach is to guarantee that medications are consistently accessible at a reasonable cost. As the name suggests, it's a coin-operated device that dispenses medication based on the user's selections. Before the pills are dispensed, the user can choose the necessary medication, pay for it, and confirm the quantity. Personnel, time, and effort are all saved. There would be no need to maintain any records if it were utilized in hospitals. Every medication that is administered is a product of the quick evolution of technology, which includes everything from electronics to nanotechnologies.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Diabetic Rethinopathy Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The Diabetic retinopathy is a disease triggered by diabetes that requires early detection in order to be effectively treated. The patient's vision may decrease as the polygenic disease advances, resulting in diabetic retinopathy. As a result, two types of diabetic retinopathy emerged: NPDR and PDR. Diabetic Retinopathy diagnosis requires careful coordination with clinicians in order to notice the presence and relevance of the various tiny options, which, combined with a sophisticated scaling system, makes this a hard and time-consuming chore. We can evaluate the likelihood of irreversible blindness by early detection. As a result, an effective and efficient system is required. The suggested research uses a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) to diagnose DR Using fundus photos, appropriately classify the severity of the condition. The harshness levels are No DR (Diabetic Retinopathy), Mild DR (Diabetic Retinopathy), Moderate DR (Diabetic Retinopathy), Severe DR (Diabetic Retinopathy) and Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy. To detect the features involved in classification and automatically deliver the diagnosis, we develop a network using Convolutional Neural Network Architecture and Data Augmentation. We use a high-end Graphics Process Unit (GPU) to train our network on an openly accessible Kaggle dataset, and the results are astounding, especially for a high-level classification challenge. Our proposed CNN obtains a 79.49 percent accuracy on the 2000 fundus pictures dataset.

articleTitle: Metamaterial-Based Microwave Absorber Using Meander Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The present study reports a metamaterial microwave absorber (MMA) using the squared split ring resonator with a meander line in the frequency range of 1–20 GHz. The CST Microwave Studio software 2019 is used to design the proposed MMA and the absorption performance in terms of S11 is analyzed based on three iterations in the frequency range of 1–20 GHz. The MMA-1, MMA-2, and MMA-3 are showing absorption performance of 93.85 at 4.1917 GHz, at 10.581 GHz, and 95.57 at 10.607 GHz respectively. The proposed design is showing the narrow-band absorption performance.

articleTitle: Design and Hardware Implementation of PV-STATCOM for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper presents a design strategy for Power Quality improvement using PV-STATCOM. Power quality is one of the major and critical aspects of modern power system to ensure reliable and efficient operation. The study establishes the integration of renewable source of energy (PV) into the grid which raises the power quality issues like voltage sag, swell and harmonics etc. So, a PV-STATCOM is proposed as a solution to improve power quality in PV system. The PV-STATCOM's design performance is demonstrated by simulation which is done by using MATLAB. Further, a hardware prototype is developed to verify the real time efficiency of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Detection of Spatial Objects Using Remotely Sensed Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Object detection of satellite imagery, which is an important but the challenging issue in this field of overview and satellite imagery, thus it plays the important role in vast range of applications and receives compelling attention in the recent years. In contrast to a few previously published analyses that focused on a critical category of things such as building and road, we focus more on the general field areas including the road, buildings, tree, car, ships, airport, central area. Published, we also discuss current academic challenges and offer two promising research guides, particularly the representation of a deeper learning-based aspect and the discovery of a weakly guided learning-based object. With the help of a GIS (a spatial information system) which is a thought-provoking framework that provides the ability to capture and analyze local and local data, we will be transcribing objects to images provided using software tools.

articleTitle: Detecting Lake Water Quality Using Machine Learning and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Accurate water quality detection is the basis of water environment management and is of great significance for water environment protection. There is no doubt that the accuracy of water quality will be improved if the multivariate correlation and time sequence data of water quality are fully used. With respect to the lakes in Bengaluru, it is being alarmingly polluted due to drains opening into the water bodies. The lakes exhibit severe pollution with high values of alkalinity, hardness, phosphates and a low level of dissolved oxygen and other non-degradable substances. This paper proposes a framework for future enhancement for water quality detection using Machine learning [6] [8] and Image Processing [7] [13] [14] which can significantly help in assessing water sources without the usage of traditional methodologies different sensors which are manual, time consuming, costly and lack real-time feedback. The methods for water quality detection using machine learning includes Multiple Linear Regression, Random Forest Regression, Support Vector Regression, Gradient Boosting Regression, Decision Tree Regression for detecting water quality index and uses Random Forest Classification, Support Vector Machine, Accuracy, Gradient Boosting Classification, Decision Tree Classification for classification purpose. These methods give a data-driven model utilized in surrogate modelling for mapping physical processes and obtaining the second degree of realism, primarily to reduce physical simulation time and expense. These algorithms can be employed in a variety of scientific domains since they have good generalization ability, high accuracy, are less prone to over-fitting, and simultaneously minimize estimate mistakes.

articleTitle: Smart Hydroponic Monitoring and Controlling System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In the places where there is restricted agricultural land such as urban areas the hydroponic system is one of the way through which they can produce vegetables in a small area or even inside the house without the need of soil just by providing a suitable environmental condition for the proper growth of the plant and providing necessary nutrients. Here we need to keep in check the pH values according to the plant and introduce Internet of the things (IoT) to the system. Here the IoT plays an important role for remote monitoring of the system which will help in maintaining all of the required values of the hydroponic system easily. For ensuring suitable environment for the proper growth of the plant we be using various sensors for taking the the values such as heat, humidity, light intensity, level of nutrient in the container, pH value of the nutrient which should be different for differ types of pants. All of these data will be send to the microcontroller (Arduino UNO) for the processing. For the output devices fan, light bulb will be used which is connected to the relay and will be activated based upon the data from the sensors. Arduino UNO will also be connected to the Wi-Fi module. The upkeep and automatic observation will be done by the intervention of the IoT that will transfer the data received by microcontroller through sensors to the Cloud where the data will get saved and the user will be able to check those data remotely through devices such as laptop or mobile phone.

articleTitle: Attendance Maintenance System with Intelligent Security
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: An ingenious face mask recognition system that uses partial detection technology to detect and verify a person's facial expressions and automatically marks their presence. But with the spread of COVID-19, millions of masks made around the world affect the accuracy of the face recognition system. Existing facial recognition solutions are no longer reliable if you wear a mask and remove the mask for further confirmation will increase the infection risk. To date, this work proposes an in-depth study framework based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), which have been trained and tested on masked and human face images. The system can detect a person's face and presence will only be recorded if the person is wearing a mask. Supervised learning is used to train databases collected from a variety of sources. The software can be used for different groups of individuals such as employees, students, etc. The system records and stores realtime data and available databases.

articleTitle: Infrasonic Sound Detection Using STM Based Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This research aimed to develop a wireless detector array capable of detecting infrasound sources with accuracy. Infrasound is a low-frequency sound that frequently rises below the 20 Hz threshold for human audibility. Several natural phenomena, including earthquakes, avalanches, lightning, and tinderboxes, produce infrasound sound waves. They may also be produced by artificial means such as machinery, windmills, gun launches, munitions, helicopters, and drones. Based on the capacity to detect, we sought to produce a product that was simple to produce, provide efficiently, install simply, and offer real-time data. It was intended for the design to employ a collection of seven separate wireless detector bumps in an indirect array that would broadcast to a central receiver ‘knot’ node. A wireless transceiver, a microprocessor, and a microphone are components of each knot. To guarantee that each module could decode sound, they were all tested together. The module was tested with two distinct microphones: a conventional range microphone (100Hz-IS kHz), and a low frequency extended microphone (6Hz-20 kHz). The final prototype's wireless module tested data transmission to 25 meters in a high-gloss, high-hindrance environment. Further testing revealed that the detector array effectively picked up sound using the low-frequency extended-range microphone, communicated, and showed the user the sound data in real time.

articleTitle: Wideband Cavity Backed Patch Anteena for S-Band Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper describes the design of a cavity-backed patch antenna with a co-axial probe. The antenna is intended for use in 2.8-3.1 GHz wireless communication radar systems. The antenna's gain and directivity are improved by using a rectangular patch (Er = 2.2, thickness = 1.6 mm) element with a hollow backing. To increase resonance and improve antenna performance, a metallic strip is placed to the patch element. The co-axial probe is used to feed radio frequency signals to the antenna. Simulating the antenna with computer-aided design tools and optimising the antenna's dimensions and feed placement to obtain the desired characteristics are all part of the design process. The cavity microstrip patch antenna's final design is constructed and tested to analyse and validate its performance. The results show that the proposed antenna performs well in terms of gain, directivity, and radiation pattern. The antenna is easy to build and inexpensive, making it appropriate for use in a variety of wireless communication and radar applications.

articleTitle: Design of Processor Interface Logics on Field Programmable Gate Array for Spacecraft On-Board Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The phrase “On Board Computer” refers to the computer of the spacecraft's avionic subsystem. The “On Board Software” is the software that implements the satellite's critical functions, such as failure detection, isolation, recovery, on-board time synchronization, attitude and orbit control, tele-command execution and distribution, telemetry gathering and formatting, and automatic thermal control. On-Board Computer uses standard interfaces like MIL-STD-1553B, SPI, UART, etc. to communicate with the rest of the spacecraft. The FPGA is used as a central arbiter for the processor, RAM, protocol chips, input-output interfaces and PROM/EEPROM. Each subsystem may use a different protocol, the FPGA should be able to accommodate the possible types. The Single Event Upset performance of the SRAM and EEPROM is enhanced by employing an error detection and correction algorithm, single error correction and double error detection. The addressable capability of generic 16-bit processor is enhanced to accommodate larger physical memory, with the help of a memory management unit. The individual modules of the project, such as Error Detection and Correction, Serial Peripheral Interface, Universal Asynchronous Receiver-Transmitter, Memory Management Unit and Wait-States logic, were designed and verified using Verilog Hardware Description Language on Xilinx Vivado platform.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Smart Aquarium for the Betterment of Aquatic Living Beings
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Numerous people today keep fish as companions in their homes. The aquarist has been feeding the creatures that live in the aquarium tanks, necessitating a suitable arrangement for upkeep. Variations in the quality of the water, nourishing fish, regulating temperature and lighting, and challenges manually assessing an aquarium's parameters are some of the issues encountered. As a result, it's important to regularly check the physical characteristics and improve the water quality. Therefore, the proposal suggests a system that has sensors and can be controlled in realtime. It monitors the water's pH level, contamination, and warmth. It also detects fish consuming food. The aquarium's state is tracked by and delivered to the user's mobile device via Internet of Things (IoT). This paper presents a solution that focuses on the implementation of smart aquarium systems using IoT technology. The review examines the different approaches and methodologies used in the studies, highlighting their strengths, weaknesses, and potential for further research. With our solution we can explore the use of IoT technology to remotely monitor and control various aspects of aquarium management, including water quality, temperature, and feeding. The research finds that while the studies demonstrate the potential of IoT technology to improve aquarium management, there are still challenges that need to be addressed, including cost, compatibility with different aquarium setups, and reliability in remote environments. As a result, sensors have been used in smart aquarium maintenance to ensure that the fish are not overfed or underfed, hence requiring less physical effort to maintain the aquarium.

articleTitle: Rash Driving Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Two wheelers are broadly used than different shape of motors because of its low value and simplicity. Drunken riding and Drowsy riding are the principal elements for such avenue injuries. Some facts suggests that 35% of the injuries are resulting from wheelers and in that 60% of the - wheeler injuries are induced because of loss of consciousness. So, our idea is to format a module that may find out the auto every time it's far rashly driven or driven above permissible pace restrict and transmit the statistics to the concerned authority. The rash riding detection is finished the usage of accelerometer sensor, ultrasonic and PIR sensor. The accelerometer will come across the velocity of the automobile, ultrasonic sensor will come across the minimal distance among the automobile and an impediment and PIR sensor will come across the gap among the automobile and the pedestrian. The rash riding popularity is similarly uploaded to database of Android Local server for action. When the driving force is riding rashly or past the velocity limit, a message could be transmitted to the proprietor or the enterprise who can screen motors.

articleTitle: Design and Development of 1KW Wind Emulator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Decades ago, conventional energy resources had a growing environmental and economic crisis. in this regard, renewable energy resources are needed to address these issues.one of them is a source of spiritual energy. Internal Loop (HIL) computer systems the simpler and less expensive method allows you to test the software and the hardware that controls the working of generator. This process was executed within Labeview based applications using an Advantech-USB-4704-AE Data acquisition card. This paper will set out all aspects of systems and operations as well as WTE control strategies namely Pitch control and MPPT. Electrical subassemblies are at high risk of operating damage, generator transmission faults are reported and investigated using terminal voltage. The main problem that researchers face with regard to turbine is the large limited area, the required turbine length and maintenance problems. The results show that the turbine tree is operated at its highest potential while reducing the load on the turbine with a strong type of wind speed. These changes are made to the human turbine naturally, so it analyses the turbine on a small scale using a new turbine technology tree. without the real need for WT's turbine simulator are often analysed.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication Of Retrofit E-Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: As the world population is increasing day by day, the demand for simple, reliable, environmentally friendly, safe, and affordable products in the manufacturing industry is increasing. One such product is E-Bicycle. Gasoline bicycles are not sustainable, and the fuel price increases with the environmental consideration. Traffic is a major issue we are facing in our daily life. E-Bicycles are used instead of conventional two wheelers for short trips, and they occupy less space hence it will be helpful in overcoming this issue. In this project, bicycle is retrofitted by advanced technologies and modified into E-Bicycle, wherein it can be operated in both pedaling and non-pedaling modes. The rider can control the motor output or speed through the throttle. It will be more affordable than the fuel-based bicycles as we use battery instead of fossil fuel. The BLDC controller is used to control the speed, acceleration, motor power, battery voltage and pedaling activities. It gets the input from the pedal assist sensor and gives the output accordingly. A hub motor which is very sleek in design and very light in weight is considered due to their low self-discharge rate, low maintenance and high energy density. Li-on battery supply the power to the drive train. Battery cooling system along with Battery management system is included. The cooling system helps in temperature management during high demand on battery. This combination can increase the life cycle of the battery and reduce the need of battery replacement.

articleTitle: Advanced Hearing Gadget
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: With technology evolving every second, it offers many advantages and eases for people who can understand and handle it. But the smart things don't provide much ease to elderly people who can't use technology efficiently. Our aim is to design a smart hearing aid which takes care of the complexity of the technology and eases it for old people. In this project we aimed at finding a way to help the elderly people automate some of their daily tasks and ease their interaction with technology. Our proposed methodology has shown how with the help of Raspberry Pi and AI assistant this could be achieved and implemented. This project will be very useful for the people who are technologically backward as well as physically disabled people. Hearing aids can help the persons with the loss in sensorineural.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Power Electronics Converter for Fast Charging in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Electric vehicles are a boon to the transportation sector, as it offers a clean and noiseless source of commute. EV's are becoming popular these days because of the several advantages it offers against conventional IC engines. As the popularity of electric vehicles are increasing so is the demand for charging stations that would charge the battery in an electric vehicle. In this paper a converter topology consisting of a Vienna rectifier and PFC controller is proposed for charging electric vehicles. The proposed converter provides several benefits such as improved power factor, reduced THD, small size of filters over conventional three phase rectifiers. Therefore the aforementioned converter bypasses the constraints of on-board chargers and can be used for DC fast charging of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Fraud Pruning in ATM Using QR Code
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: We are aware that the current technology under implementation to withdraw money is that we use an ATM card in which the data is incorporated in the magnetic stripe, and the user must enter a four-digit secure PIN for transactions. This method is prone to many frauds such as ATM card skimming, reply attack, shoulder surfing, and video recording with hidden cameras, which occur at ATM terminals. This paper proposes a novel approach for fraud pruning at ATM terminals by eliminating the need for ATM cards making them contactless and secure. The proposed methodology uses mobile, to which after authentication, a unique code will be sent by the server and the same is used to generate the QR code. The generated QR code needs to be scanned through the ATM.

articleTitle: Autonomous Buoy Based Water Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Water quality of domestic water bodies is being degraded by harmful pollutants due to the discharge of domestic drains and interconnecting water bodies. This project proposes a real time water quality monitoring system using IoT (Internet of Things). The system consists of several sensors which are used to measure physical and chemical parameters such as temperature, pH, turbidity, dissolved oxygen, Total dissolved solids (TDS) of the water. Additionally, this remote control system is especially for lakes reservoirs, rivers. To monitor water quality in such complicatedscale water environment, we use a buoy which can float and move on the water simply by using automated/manual controller. This buoy includes an embedded Global Positioning System (GPS) which gives the location of the point wherever water quality is being monitored. All the results are being generated and displayed with their readings, as a data sheet.

articleTitle: Smart Ration Material Distribution Using RFID and Biometric Authentication
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The government has setup public distribution system shops which provide ration at less cost than bazaar cost so as to help people who are economically backward. Ration is being dispensed in these shops manually by vendors which consumes more man power while it might also lead to corruption wherein the vendor might use the ration provided to him for his/her own personal benefit and sell it in order to make money. Thus, it is better if the system is automated and the consumer can himself obtain the ration by providing necessary data before obtaining it. The proposed system uses fingerprint biometric along with Radio Frequency Identity (RFID) card to authenticate the user. It then allows him to enter the quantity of the ration which is quantified with the help of load cell. Once the required quantity is read by the load cell, the ration is dispensed.

articleTitle: An Architecture for IoT Server Using Firebase RTDB for Various IoT Projects
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The increasing use of IoT devices with multiple requirements has made it necessary to develop a new architecture that can support new features. While there have been developments in individual sectors, there are limited platforms available to support different features such as Machine Learning, Data-Analytics, Voice Recognition, Multi-device OTA (Over The Air) Updates, API (Application Programming Interface) supports, and Data Storage support. Our proposed architecture for an IoT server utilizes Firebase real-time database (RTDB). It also provides efficient data storage and management capabilities that enable fast and secure access to data by hardware and software systems. The system facilitates instant reflex actions for data transmissions, allowing for quick and efficient control of connected devices. The architecture features two approaches, Reflex Processor, and Functional Processor. The Functional Processor contains modules such as machine learning support, data analytics, voice recognition, data-lake, online code editor with OTA (Over The Air) update functionality, and a secondary API for external websites or Android apps. Our proposed architecture provides a comprehensive solution for the efficient and easy creation of various IoT projects, making it an ideal platform for both IoT enthusiasts and students.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Peltier Based Mobile Solar Vaccine Refrigerator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Renewable energy is seen as a promising solution to the ever-increasing problem of environmental degradation and energy scarcity. Increasing level of carbon-dioxide emission and the corresponding depletion of ozone layer has become a primary concern for both the developed and the developing nations. This paper describes a design and implementation of Peltier based mobile solar vaccine refrigerator. The proposed system does not need any kind of refrigerant and it maintains temperature between 2 degrees Celsius to 8 degrees Celsius within the refrigerator which is required to store vaccines. Peltier devices are used to provide the cooling effect in the refrigerator. LM35 sensor is used to display the internal temperature of the refrigerator. The model can be used to transport vaccines to rural areas where availability of electrical power is limited.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Analysis of Off-Grid Connected Hybrid Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The techno-economic analysis conducted using HOMER software determined the best hybrid renewable system design for the location. The chosen system architecture consists of solar panels, a wind turbine, a diesel generator, and battery storage. The results showed that this design achieves the lowest Cost of Energy (COE) at $0.338/kWh, the least Net Present Cost (NPC) at $3.45 million, and the largest Renewable Fraction (RF) of 100%. This means the system can provide 100% power supply to meet the village's load demand of 2589.69 kWh/day, with 70% of the energy generated from renewable sources. Overall, this system offers a cost-effective solution, ensuring reliable power supply while minimizing environmental impact.

articleTitle: Efficient Framework for Diagnosis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Using Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The aberrant growth of white blood cells in the blood and myeloid tissue is the hallmark of leukaemia, which pathologists find it by observing at a blood smear viewed through a microscope. To identify and define leukaemia, pathologists look at the quality of the cells and their physical properties. Microscopic image analysis is crucial for the early leukaemia screening and accurate diagnosis, because current approaches depend on manual inspection, which is tedious and strongly reliant on province specialist's knowledge. Computerized leukaemia diagnosis reveals new possibilities for the eliminating human intrusion while also giving better accurate objective data. This paper provides a framework for automatic identification of acute lymphoblastic leukaemia from outermost blood smear pictures predicted on traditional digital Image Processing techniques and Machine Learning algorithms. This method of automated leukaemia identification was found to be more effective, fast and precise.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Cloud Platform for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This project aims at controlling electrical loads with the help of Node mcu ESP8266 using our web application. This project helps at reducing the wastage of electricity. By using the web application, it helps us to remotely access loads or devise and thus implement wireless technology. The design involves the use of Node mcu and the applications are connected using wires and breadboard. The communication between the platform and Node mcu is wireless. The authentication generation will ensure only authorized users access. This IoT system designed will help control electrical loads from anywhere through wireless technology.

articleTitle: Air Quality Monitoring System Using IOT for Enchanced Living Environments and Public Health
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper hand out with gauging Air Quality using MQ2,MQ4MMQ7,MQ8 and MQ135 sensor along with dust sensor and DHT22sensor. Gauging Air Quality is a chief element for conducting lot of recognition in the humans to look after the future peer group a healthier being. ‘Single Stroke’ and ‘Double stroke engine’ is being banned by government of India to as it produces heavy pollutants on to the air. The main objective of our paper is to create awareness among the people by using IOT platforms like Thingspeak. New Delhi is being is noted as the Air quality about 300 ppm making it the most polluted city in the entire world. Here in our paper, we have calibrated the sensors properly. Here a dashboard is setup wherein it is easier for public to know the air quality around them easily in easiest platform like that of the things speak. Also, the effective cost of the components is also reduced as compared to that of other paper.

articleTitle: Design of Earthquake Simulation Model and Flood Detection System for Alert and Warning Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Recent floods in Kerala and Meghalaya and earthquake in Kathmandu has driven the authorities to look for an efficient way to detect the calamities and to provide alert earlier. Earthquake and Floods affect the human life and environment adversely and cause enormous damage and losses every now and then. Due to these calamities, there has also been an increase in death rates of human life and fauna. Therefore, it is required to develop a real time system which provides warning about these disasters is essential. The proposed system is aimed at monitoring earthquake vibrations and water level using sensors and provides alert signal to the authorities using GSM modem which is interfaced with NodeMCU (ESP8266) microcontroller. MPU6050's Accelerometer is used to measure the seismic vibrations. Float sensor or water level sensor is used to measure the water level in the river or dam. An alert message in form of SMS is sent to the appropriate authorities via their mobile phones with the GPS location of the affected area and to the people residing in the flood and earthquake prone areas through mobile app.

articleTitle: Real-Time Face Recognization and Head Pose Estimation Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a rapidly growing field that involves the development of intelligent machines that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. The field of AI encompasses a wide range of techniques, including machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics. Real-time face recognition and head pose estimation using artificial intelligence is a cutting-edge technology that has revolutionized the field of computer vision. The technology aims to accurately and reliably identify and track human faces and their associated head poses in real-time, even in complex and dynamic environments. This is achieved through the use of deep learning algorithms, such as RNN s, that are trained on large datasets of labeled facial images to learn the features and patterns of human faces and their associated head poses.

articleTitle: Smart E-Uniform for Soldiers
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The modern battlefield demands advanced technologies to equip soldiers with enhanced capabilities and ensure their safety. The introduction of smart electronic uniforms, referred to as Smart E-Uniforms, has emerged as a groundbreaking solution. This abstract explores the concept and benefits of Smart E-Uniforms for soldiers without plagiarizing existing sources. smart E-Uniforms are a revolutionary advancement in soldier equipment that integrates cutting-edge electronics and materials. These uniforms enhance combat performance and safety by incorporating sensors, communication systems, advanced materials, and power management solutions. The integration of these features enables real-time health monitoring, improved situational awareness, seamless communication, enhanced protection, and prolonged operation in the field. Smart E-Uniforms have the potential to revolutionize modern warfare and safeguard the lives of military personnel. One of the key elements of Smart E-Uniforms is the integration of sensors and embedded devices. These sensors can monitor vital signs, body temperature, and fatigue levels, providing real-time health monitoring to ensure soldiers' well-being during combat. Additionally, the uniform can be equipped with environmental sensors to detect chemical or biological hazards, alerting soldiers to potential threats.

articleTitle: Dielectric Resonator Based Wideband Circularly Polarized Antenna for Wireless Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Conventional antennas were bulky in nature, experienced metallization losses had limited bandwidth, and were vulnerable to multipath fading and interference. Dielectric Resonators (DR) has a significant deal of potential for radiating electromagnetic waves. Dielectric Resonators lessen the antenna's total metallization, which lowers metallization losses. In this literature, a wideband circularly polarized antenna with a miniaturized Dielectric Resonator is shown. The antenna comprises a substrate, a ground plane, a patch, and a Dielectric Resonator that have been placed on the patch. A meandered shaped patch, rotated by 45° with respect to the +Z-axis is designed to implement the phase quadrature required for circular polarization, which leads to circular polarization characteristics. Implementation of a Dielectric Resonator also helps in bandwidth enhancement. A simple partial ground is used to reduce the back propagation of waves. The designed antenna achieves a wide return loss bandwidth of 6 to 12.4 GHz (69.56%) as well as circular polarization characteristics, in the frequency range of 7 to 12 GHz (52.63%). Hence this antenna can be used for a variety of modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: An IOT Based Smart Monitoring and Controlling System for Garden
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network, also known as the WSN, enables Global Sensing cut across several present dwelling zones. The ability to calculate and comprehend environmental indicators is made possible by this. Gardens may experience challenges with dryness and rotting. Through constant monitoring of variables like moisture in the soil, temperature humidity, and water level, the primary goal of this project is to preserve the natural characteristics of the plants. The roots of the plants have sensors placed for these characteristics. The user receives the data that the system has identified. The goal is to use Arduino UNO and Wi-Fi to get data and synchronize those values with the internet.

articleTitle: Application of NeRF for Visual Conversion of 2D Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: We describe a method for combining visual effects of complicated sceneries with good quality outcomes by increasing continuous volume function with a small selection of input views. Our technique provides a site that employs a deep (completely integrated) deep network with a single continuous 5D connection (local area (x, y, z) and viewing area as well as output volume. We combine viewing by requesting 5D links with camera radiation and using archetypal volume rendering method to produce convex exit colors in the image since the volume rendering is obviously separated, which is the only input, sophisticated geometry and appearance, and we show the results beyond the previous neural rendering function and display combination.

articleTitle: IoT Monitoring System for Medical Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Biomedical Waste (BMW) management is an important aspect in the field of medicine. The hazardous waste generated by hospitals must be managed properly on a timely basis. An IoT-based BMW system is proposed to monitor and track the proper disposal of waste. It consists of three levels of monitoring, hospital information monitoring, transportation monitoring, and medical waste treatment facility monitoring. A webpage is developed to provide the status of waste bins and the GPS tracking of transport vehicles. The system aids in the promotion of a healthy and risk-free lifestyle.

articleTitle: Enhancing Learning for Visually Impaired People and Currency Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Visually impaired people are unaware of the difficulties facing in their normal daily life. Visual impairment or the defect in vision is the term which is used by the experts to define any kind of issues related to the vision loss, whether it's someone who cannot see at all or someone who has partial vision loss. They are facing many challenges while performing their daily activities. Sight and vision are important because they allow us to connect with our surroundings, keep us safe, and help maintain the sharpness of our minds. So we are doing the needful by one of the object detection algorithm based on deep learning is Mobile-Net SSD Single Shot Multi-Box Detector. It navigates the people about the object and provides the audio to insist them towards the object. The algorithm which we have used in realtime detection along with the camera to detect the currency which is fed through image stream which in dumped in the Raspberry Pi by the camera fixed on the spectacle.

articleTitle: Bomb Disposal Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Robots play a vital role in human endeavour on a daily basis and are capable of doing complex tasks quickly and accurately. Robots are used to mimic human behaviour and then apply these behaviours to abilities that lead to the completion of a certain activity in order to address the obstacles that disabled individuals encounter in society. This paper describes a wireless bomb disposal robot that can aid in the defence of our country against terrorists, suicide bombers, and other threats. Robots are increasingly being controlled wirelessly. In this study, we explain the appearance of a robot that is controlled manually by the user via an Android mobile device. We use Wi-Fi because it connects mobile devices and, as a result, robots. The frames for the robotic arm were made of light-weight steel iron, and the Node MCU Esp32 wi-fi module, L293D Motor Driver, and proximity sensor was used. The robot we've created is guided by controls that take input from a person and perform actions in response to those inputs. If the detected metal turns out to be a bomb, the user uses his phone to operate the robot and detonate the explosives.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Solar PV Emulator Using NI Labview
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Generally, the laboratory testing environment of photovoltaic (PV) panel is very complex, expansive and ineffective due to failure of maintaining the constant climatic conditions. Hence, the overall development of PV system becomes very less as a result, PV emulators were introduced, together with the maximum power point tracking algorithm (MPPT), and Chopper was used to power the PV inverter in a laboratory environment. In this research paper, the various internal blocks of PV emulators are mathematically formulated with theoretical background, and the final expressions are implemented in Commercial software LabVIEW. Followed that, the obtained simulation results are validated through experimental results which are available in Literature. It concludes that the simulated results are approximately matched with experimental results with around 12 % of Error. Then, we evaluated the designed PV emulator to recharge a 12V-7 Ah batteries for testing the overall performance.

articleTitle: Biomedical Tongue Image Color Analysis for Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Tongue examination is an effective prescient methodology for checking the wellbeing of interior organs and recognizing infections associated with them. Abnormalities of the tongue can provide a diagnostic and therapeutic hint for physicians. The examination of the tongue is divided into two parts: an examination of the tongue body; and an examination of the tongue coat, which is also sometimes called the moss. The covering or greenery on the tongue's surface shows the ongoing state of the patient's metabolism and digestion, as well as the presence of poisons or potentially dreary, particularly in the gastrointestinal system. The dampness of the tongue gives some sign about the condition of hydration of the body. The general shade of the assortment of the tongue shows the general state of the blood and the circulation system, and the fundamental harmony between humors and supplements. Staining of the tongue body restricted in a specific reflex zone of the tongue shows a lopsidedness happening in its relating organ. Color and textural data are retrieved from tongue photos and utilized to train classification models that detect related disorders. The main goal of this study is to classify photographs of tongues that are healthy or have been diagnosed with thyroid, heart disease, or gastritis.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of APB and AHB Lite Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The Verification is very crucial in the VLSI segment. APB and the AHB Lite protocols are the prime focus in this paper. The AMBA consists of the APB (Advanced Peripheral Bus) and the AHB (Advanced High-performance Bus). Unlike the AHB, APB follow the non-pipelined convention. Inside the IC communication takes place between the master and the slave using both the models. Verilog language and testbench is used to perform synthesis and design. The data transfer is the most critical aspect that is very important in the communication process involving the master and the slave cells of the IC. Both APB and the AHB deal with the communication itself. The basic understanding of the APB and the AHB protocol is dealt with here and how efficiently the data is transmitted from the master to the slave is seen. We should always use a protocol that will transfer data at a higher speed, offer more modes of transmission, provide security to the data that is being transmitted and also ensure that less power is consumed in the entire process. If a protocol can satisfy all of the above properties, then it is ideal to use that protocol for our communication.

articleTitle: Life Saving Helmet Under Hazardous Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Particularly with the rising risks of air pollution and gas explosions, mineworkers safety is essential. A smart helmet has been developed to address this problem; it can recognize harmful gases and automatically close the shield of the helmet which helps in rescuing the miner. The helmet has different sensors that can detect when it is taken off; if this occurs, a notification is sent to the control room. A panic button that activates in the event of an accident and sending a signal to the control room is installed. By offering real-time monitoring and risk identification, the use of this smart helmet in mining operations can considerably increase the safety of miners. The information which is collected from the sensors will be sent to the control room through wireless network. All sizes of mining companies can use it for low-cost communication. Additionally, the use of IR sensors and panic buttons can aid in accident prevention and enable quick action in case of emergencies. Operators can easily monitor the possible dangers and eventually the same is displayed on LCD panel in the control room.

articleTitle: Smart Bike Monitoring System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The smart bike monitoring system using IoT is a modern solution that integrates the internet of things technology into bikes. The system includes various sensors and devices that collects data from the bike and its surroundings. This information is then analyzed and processed to monitor bike performance, detect any faults and provide insights to improve bike usage. The system is connected to the internet, allowing bike owners to monitor their bike. The system provides features such as to monitor the vehicle to follow the lane, avoid accidents by enabling auto braking system, improve safety by alerting the owner in case of accidents or emergencies, detect the emission of smoke in engine, turn on headlights when dense fog is detected and also to provide real time alerts and notifications on web page.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Low-Cost Mechanical Ventilator with Remote Patient Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In the last few years, there has been a huge development in the health sector. But still, there are many villages and small areas that lack proper facilities for treatment. From the survey, it is observed that people living in these areas face a lot more health issues than people in urban areas. During COVID times people faced a lot of difficulties to get proper treatment. Even people with normal flue, primary breathing problems, and other common diseases couldn't get proper treatment because of no proper recommendations from doctors. There was even a shortage of beds and ventilators. Keeping all this in mind we designed a compact model based on IOT with 4 physiological parameters pulse rate, temperature, oxygen level, and blood pressure which can be measured in one model, also provides oxygen for people with low SpO2. It is affordable for everyone, making it cost-effective, reliable, and easy for people to operate. There is one more feature for people to get assistance from the doctors. 4 sensors are used to get the values from 4 parameters sent to the webserver with the help of raspberry pi. In the web server, a medical expert with a login Id and password can monitor and assist if required. This work provides a realtime solution so as soon as a person measure any of the 4 parameters, it is displayed on the admin's screen to visualize.

articleTitle: Border and Weather Alert Security System for Fishermen
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Border and weather alert security system for fisherman is one such system which safeguards the fishermen by alerting the marine border by the use of GPS receiver & GSM module. GPS receiver will track the border area by the help of satellites. Tracked location value can be compared with the pre-defined values in the controller. The border is split up into four zones i.e., safe zone, warning zone, danger zone and restricted zone. If the boat crosses the warning zone, LCD displays some warning message. If the boat crosses danger zone, buzzer will turn ON with some message displayed in LCD. If the boat goes on moving and touches the border, the engine automatically turned OFF and alert SMS sent to the fisherman as well as coastal control stations. Weather alerting is done by using some sensors like flow, rain, humidity and temperature. All these sensors are connected with the controller and send the output to it. Controller will send message to LCD based on the values comes from the sensors. Security alert system will be placed in the engine room of the boat. If leakage of gasses or fire sparked in the engine room, flame and gas sensors will sense it and give the output to the controller. Based on this, controller send an alert SMS to the fisherman and displays a message in the LCD.

articleTitle: Design of Omnidirectional Antenna Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper represents a design of antenna positioning system based on received signal strength indicator (RSSI) and line of sight (LOS). A kind of antenna capable of automatically changing its direction according to the strongest signal received using stepper and servo motors. The signal transmitted is received by receiver with least possible delay in line of sight. The strongest signal is measured and compared with the help of RSSI which helps forming a wireless communication. This is achieved by using arduino mega 2560 which is interfaced with the transmitter-receiver RF module for the transmission of data between antennas. The RF modules then connected to stepper motor and tilt servo motor to rotate the antenna with respect to the strongest signal received in the direction of line of sight.

articleTitle: Landmine Detection and Underwater Mine Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Landmine detection robots are specialized robots designed to detect landmines. These robots are equipped with advanced sensing technologies such as metal detectors, and cameras, which enable them to detect and locate landmines hidden in the ground. Landmine detection robots are essential in areas where landmines pose a significant threat to human life and safety, such as war zones and post-conflict areas. Landmine detection robots offer several advantages over traditional landmine detection methods, such as manual detection and clearance. These robots can cover large areas quickly and accurately, reducing the time and cost required for landmine clearance. Additionally, landmine detection robots can operate in hazardous and inaccessible areas, reducing the risk of injury or death to human deminers. The detection and clearance of underwater mines are challenging tasks, as the water environment can impede visibility and the movement of equipment. Traditional underwater mine detection and clearance methods involve human divers, who manually search for and remove mines, a dangerous and time-consuming task.

articleTitle: Real Time Arduino Based Cardiac Disease Detection Using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: For Detection and Treatment of cardiovascular illness electrocardiograms (ECGs) are used which records the real time electrical activity of the heart through leads. The current ECG Monitoring equipments are bulky and costly. Although some portable ECG devices are available, no devices give the probable condition of heart. In this paper a novel heart condition using ECG signal is proposed where the real time ECG signal is acquired through AD8232 sensor and classified using Random Forest Neural Network [1]. The implementation shows 99.43% accuracy.

articleTitle: Latency Analysis for Emergency Networks Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: One of the information and communication technologies hailed as a chance to lessen society's total environmental footprint is wireless technology, which offers new methods to interact. Latency is a parameter that affects the performance of basic business functions, and its implications are a detriment to any sort of future-proofing. Many applications that demand low latency depend on it to enhance user experience and boost customer satisfaction by facilitating faster, more fluid application operation. We proposed solution methods to measure and minimize the latency time of the emergency message transmitted from the sender to the receiver. The latency measured is about 18 milliseconds and above. The proposed system is superior in terms of latency reduction to the existing system. Aside from alerts and warnings, emergency communication systems may also contain instructions on evacuation, curfews, and other self-preservation measures, as well as details on the state of the response, family members, the help that is available, and other issues that could affect the response and recovery.

articleTitle: Smart Interactive Water Bottle
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Smart interactive water bottles have gained popularity as an innovative technology to help individuals track and manage their water intake. These bottles are equipped with sensors and Bluetooth connectivity, allowing them to communicate with a smartphone app and provide personalized hydration goals, reminders, and tracking of water intake. This paper comprehensively reviews the design, development, and effectiveness of smart interactive water bottles. The paper discusses the importance of proper hydration and the challenges associated with tracking and managing water intake. It provides an overview of the sensors and technologies used in smart water bottles, and how they are used to measure water intake and communicate with smartphone apps. Additionally, the paper analyzes the effectiveness of smart water bottles in promoting hydration and improving overall health outcomes. This paper aims to provide a detailed understanding of the features and benefits of smart interactive water bottles and their potential applications in various settings. By examining the latest research and developments in this field, we hope to highlight the potential impact of smart water bottles on hydration management and overall health and wellness.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Battery Management System for Automated Car Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The battery management system (BMS) is an essential component of electric and hybrid cars. The BMS's aim is to ensure safe and dependable battery operation. To keep up this, we need to monitor two parameter indicators, Charge Status and Health Status. SoC reflects the battery's current capacity expressed in terms of its rated capacity, and precise SoC is required in the control circuit to provide optimal charging process control. Battery life is very much affected by the temperature of the battery also Overvoltage and over charging affects the battery life drastically. Machine Learning is used to eliminate these problems and improve the battery life. Machine Learning uses battery parameters to estimate the charging pattern of the battery from the solar panel. In order to prevent complete draining of the battery and to provide uninterrupted power source to automated vehicle, two batteries are used on board. Also, the charging and discharging processes are autonomous in the system design, boosting system reliability. The batteries are powered from solar panel and regulated to give a constant supply. Dual battery selectors and a clever microprocessor are used to provide energy to the system as needed. While one battery charges from the solar panel, the other battery discharges. Machine learning is employed to control the charging of the battery by taking into account the temperature and voltage of the battery. This prevents complete draining of the battery and controlled charging pattern, thus increasing the life of the battery.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Multi-Sensor Bomb Detection and Detonation Robot System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Bomb Disposal Robot, is a device that detects bombs and assists in their destruction. The creation of a multi-sensor bomb detection and detonation robot system project addresses critical safety concerns, enhances operational efficiency, and drives technological advancements in the field, ultimately aiming to protect lives and infrastructure from the threats posed by explosive devices. The robot is equipped with an articulated arm and a holding mechanism for holding unusual objects. The system also includes realtime data transmission and wireless communication for remote control. This includes sensors like proximity, chemical and MQ-7 sensors, arms, wireless camera, and DC motors for the robot to move. Also, a GPS module is present for tracing the exact location of the bomb. Bomb Disposal Robot uses a system designed to find explosives using a user-controlled robot via an Android app. The bomb detection and detonation procedures are highly complex and hazardous operations. They require well-trained professionals with expertise in explosives, specialized equipment, and adherence to strict safety protocols to ensure the safety of personnel and the surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IoT Concepts for Health and Safety Parameters in Smart Refrigerator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The advancement of technology and people's busy schedules., they are increasingly using smarter technologies that can simplify their lives. A healthy and prosperous lifestyle is made possible by the modern kitchen appliances in your home. Refrigerator is one such appliance. A smart refrigeration module can use sensors to transform any current refrigerator into a smart., affordable unit. Smart refrigerator compares the status of the food based on weight., quantity. The removal of food spoiling., reduction of illness., and improvement of modern human living will be the significance of this study. A machine learning system that classifies the vegetables based on their colors is used to provide recipe suggestions depending on the items in the basket which in turn suggests a particular recipe. It will be intelligent enough to alert us to the food products' present status using an Android app on our phone.
