articleTitle: Implementation of Deep Image Compressors for Raw Image Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Deep image compressors are extensively practiced presently conducive to reduce the complications of conventional image compression algorithms, namely JPEG, run-Iength-encoding etc. The primary focal point using the image compression algorithm and deep image compressors is to reduce the fidelity errors in the nonlinear standard RGB (SRGB) color space. Anyhow, to train computers to interpret the visual world, that is for computer vision tasks it requires minimally processed raw image data from the image sensors. To reconstruct the original raw-RGB, small amount of metadata are fixed inside the JPEG image. The traditional JPEG encryption is of raw-RGB reconstruction. To accomplish our objective, extensive structure was used that enables deep networks aiming compression to contemplate the raw reconstruction loss and image fidelity errors. To represents this accession in two structures, Network trains sRGB fidelity loss to modify raw reconstruction loss. The integrated approach leads to considerable advancement in PSNR measured by SSIM.

articleTitle: Design of a Matching Network for a High Frequency Monopole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The paper presents a technique for designing an impedance matching circuit for high frequency monopole antennas, operating at frequency range of 3-15MHz, instead of designing and working on the network topology and altering properties for the antenna, here we designed a matching network of one fixed topology. An impedance matching network type L and C is used while designing the matching circuit, which is composed of two capacitor, two inductors and one resistor, each component in the network are being optimized using genetic algorithm in order to widen the bandwidth at the feeding point of the monopole antenna. This is done through the simulation software Advanced Design System (ADS). And our main purpose is to reduce the antenna's impedance mismatch, so that the network can be developed in a simple manner the bandwidth <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{VSWR} < 31)$</tex>, of 3-15MHz is obtained.

articleTitle: Lake Water Contamination Level Monitoring Using Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicle (ROUV)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Water is an essential element of life. Pure water requirements are increasing daily, but due to contamination in water bodies, the water supply is not meeting requirements. Contamination of water is mainly due to the disposal of waste from industries and agriculture. The quality of water can be measured using the factors such as pH, Turbidity (NTU), Conductivity, Temperature, BOD, and COD. Therefore, there must be some technology to test the level of water quality in real-time. Using current technologies such as Robots (ROUV) and the Internet of Things which includes sensors, water quality monitoring can be done in real-time. In this paper, a Remotely operated underwater vehicle was developed to collect the water sample and measure its quality based on IoT. This model consists of a microcontroller, Arduino, and sensors that can measure the parameters of the water such as pH and Turbidity. The ROUV developed is controlled by using an android application that has customized Joystick. With the help of these sensors, the level of water quality can be measured and it is displayed to the user.

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning Based Web App for Glaucoma Detection Using Low-Cost Ophthalmoscopic Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Glaucoma is the most fundamental cause of irreversible blindness in persons over a few decades. The condition is extremely prevalent in several nations, and in the worst-case situation is that many countries do not have enough ophthalmologists. According to data from a global glaucoma research, roughly 12 million individuals would be symbiotically blind from early-stage glaucoma by 2020. To evaluate the disease in the eye, fundus photography is used. Fundus photos require a lengthy visual inspection. The transfer-learning based web-app for glaucoma detection utilizing low-cost ophthalmoscopic cameras is presented in this paper. Fundus evaluation is an important part of an eye exam that helps the web-app provide vital diagnostic information to both ophthalmologists and non-ophthalmologists. The vision impairment occurs over time because it is not a rapid consequence. Only in the later stages those signs are noticed. The optic nerve was studied using 2-Dimensional retinal fundus pictures, which is a difficult task that can result in a significant cost for detecting regular glaucoma. There are a variety of different tests that can be used to rule out glaucoma, including tonometry which signifies pressure on eye, gonioscopy which examines angle is closed or open, OCT - Optical Coherence Tomography, Ophthalmoscopic Imaging to visualize retina as well as optic nerve and Fundus Copying. In this paper, an effective embedded based eye testing architecture is presented.

articleTitle: Transmission System Fault Detection Using IoT and Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Since the development of distribution and transmission networks, the goal of power system engineers has been the identification of the problem site. India significantly relies on electric power networks for both domestic and industrial use. Unfortunately, the electrical power distribution systems waste 30% or more of the energy that is transmitted from the power plants to the final destination. The main goal of our research is to build a mobile gadget that can move along high-power transmission lines while continuously analysing various factors, such as electrical values like current and voltage. The device notifies the relevant parties via IoT in the event of any malfunctions. The device is environmentally friendly because it measures variables like voltage 12.23V, current 0.3A, location, and temperature 28.86° C and uses solar panels in conjunction with a battery. The cost of manual inspection and necessitate direct physical contact with the high-voltage equipment being inspected.

articleTitle: Smart Mask for Active Defense
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Face masks protect against airborne infections and infectious agents, such as COVID-19, in an effective, simple, and low-cost manner. Existing masks only provide passive protection, operating just like an air filter for the nose or mouth. According to the report, this gadget has been outfitted along with sophisticated detectors that perceives the existence of drifting viruses in actual-time and use necessary action to restrict this threat. This methodology makes use of a control system that detects suspended particles of various size near the mask and makes smart decisions to reduce their concentration. In this current design, the in-built controller helps to maintain the air quality using PM sensors, there by triggering piezo transducers to generate a mist to collide with the particles and drop them to the ground. The device can liaise with the user via an Android/IOS application that sends various alerts. If desired, the user can override the onboard control system and use the app to personally operate the fog generator.

articleTitle: Smart Gardener
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: As the world is trending into new technologies, it is a necessary goal to trend up with the grass cutting also. The present model of lawn mower uses IC (Internal Combustion) engine. The IC engine emits the hazardous gases (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), and thus increases air pollution. The cutter powered by an IC engine is more expensive as compared to the proposed model. The price of the fuel and the cost of maintaining such a traditional machine is higher. To eliminate these disadvantages, a new form of grass cutter which is economically feasible compared to the previous one with the less maintenance cost is made. Grass cutting machines are becoming popular these days. The project's goal is to create a grass cutter that runs on a battery source, and hence reduces involvement of human being. The robot is equipped with the obstacle detection mechanism. The IR sensors on the either side helps the device to move right and left side. Grass cutters runs by itself, therefore they do not require an operator.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Antenna with Loaded Metamaterial Ground
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: This paper proposes a design of a microstrip antenna with a metamaterial loaded ground. Incorporation of loaded metamaterial defected ground structure (DGS) improves the gain, and bandwidth of the antenna. Computer Simulation Technology Microwave Studio (CST MWS) software is used to design the proposed antenna and analyze the performance. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed antenna-l achieves a −10dB dual bandwidth response of 110MHz (2.3 1 GHz-2.42GHz), 470MHz(4.21GHz-4.68GHz) between 2.36 GHz to 4.422 GHz. Antenna-2 achieves −10dB dual bandwidth response of 220MHz (2.98GHz-3.20GHz), 690MHz(3.55GHz-4.24GHz), between 3.0994 GHz to 3.6346 GHz.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Retinex Variational Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The major problems of underwater images are fuzz, under-exposure, color distortion because the light travels into deep ocean undergoes refraction, absorption and scattering. In this paper, we have developed two methods and they are: Adaptive retinal mechanism and Improved retinex enhancement. In both the methods we have used several processes to avoid the noise and distortion of the image. The results of both the methods are compared and the histograms are also drawn for each stage of the process. Then, the final output image obtained is enhanced in terms of color details, corrections, naturalness preservation and well defined edges.

articleTitle: Efficient Implementation of Lookup Table-Based Numerically Controlled Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The design of signal generators is essential in numerous chip-based systems. (SoCs). Major signals, including cosine, sine, linear frequency modulated (LFM), and Gaussian, among others, must be produced on-chip. These signals are produced in a digital system by numerically controlling them and converting them using a non-coherent oscillator (NCO). Because of this, an effective NCO block design is crucial. For the creation of sine and cosine signals, the design of an effective Lookup Table (LUT) based NCO is presented in this paper. For the creation of sine and cosine signals, the design of an efficient search table (LUT)-based NCO is presented here. The suggested NCO can produce sinusoidal and cosine signals in one block and is efficient hardware.

articleTitle: Underground Cable Fault Detection Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The major goal of this work is to use an Arduino to determine the distance in kilometer where a failure in an underground cable occurred from the base station. In urban settings, the underground cable technique is the most popular. While a defect might develop for any reason, the mending process for that cable is difficult due to a lack of understanding of the location where the fault occurred. This suggested system will locate the exact location of the fault. This proposed system is made up of a series of resistors that represent the cable length in kilometers and a set of switches that simulate problems. To confirm, the fault is made at every known km.

articleTitle: Self Automated Kinematic Smart Haptic Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Robotics is an engineering discipline that focuses on the design and development of robots and their associated technologies. The main goal of robotics is to create new technologies that are versatile, user-friendly, and capable of processing and analysing vast amounts of data. Researchers in this field are interested in automating various tasks by using sensors to convey information about the environment to the robotic arm. They are also focused on implementing analytical concepts in robotics to improve their functionality. Nowadays, many industries rely heavily on robotic machinery, which is used in a wide range of manufacturing factories. For instance, these devices can be used in the medical field or manufacturing companies. They act as controllers for industrial robotic arms and offer more precision and ease-of-use than their predecessors. With these devices, programming a robotic arm to complete multiple tasks at once is much simpler. Ultimately, the aim of developing these devices is to bridge the gap between robots and humans.

articleTitle: IOT Based Real-Time Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The Internet of Things, which has emerged with the advancement of information technology, possesses the traits of strong permeability, extensive use of action, and beneficial overall effects. It encourages the advancement of Internet of Things technologies for structural engineering detection. It supports the creation of sophisticated, networked systems that are intelligent. The most frequent danger to bridge safety is cracks. A real-time automated system for monitoring the health of bridges has been made possible by advances in sensor technology. (1) Monitoring equipment that is installed in the bridge environment makes up this system. (2) Hardware for transferring data between the cloud-based server and the bridge monitoring system. (3) A dynamic database that keeps track of bridge state information. (4) A cloud-based server that computes and interprets the information sent from the monitoring devices. The circumstances of a bridge and its surroundings, including the neighboring water levels, pipelines, air quality, and other safety concerns, can be analyzed and monitored by this system in real time. The users can check the state of the bridge in real time using mobile communications devices thanks to the transmission of the detected data and photographs to the server and database.

articleTitle: Real Time Patient Robot to Aid Chronic Diseased People in the Health Care Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Chronic diseases are becoming more widespread. Treatment and monitoring of these diseases require more and more safety and sometimes it would affect the doctors and nurses, which increases the risk of hospitals and patients. Presently, advancements in wearable sensors and communication protocol contribute to enriching the healthcare system in a way that will reshape healthcare services shortly. The system makes use of a robotic vehicle with 4-wheel drive for easy navigation. The robot also includes a controller box for circuitry and a mounting to hold a mobile phone or tablet the mobile or tablet is used to hold live video calls. The robot includes a rack which contains the essential medicines in it. Our robot is designed in a way that, the robot can deliver the medicines, food and other essential things and monitor vitals and contact the nurse if any potential risk. The feature of virtual contact with the doctor will be there. The nurse can use an IOT based panel to control the robot.

articleTitle: Design and Development of IoT Based Robotic Arm Using Conveyor Belt
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) are most widely used for controlling the robots. The robotic arm is controlled using a Python-based IoT framework. This also enables the robots to be controlled by checking for unique login credentials. Apparatus and Bots are now playing an increasingly essential part in the computerization business. This paper explains how a robotic arm is created using the Internet of Things for Commanding and Integrating commercial processes. With the use of servo motor, we can now see the robotic arm can move in four directions. When a servo motor moves, the micro-controller turns the analogue signal into a digital signal that the servo motor can understand.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Intelligent Ignition System (IIS) for EVs AND IC Engine Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: The current situation demonstrates that drunk driving causes the majority of traffic accidents. Every human attempt made to curb drinking and driving on the edge is undermined by enforcement officials' limited capabilities. Therefore, a system that can detect alcohol without being constrained by time or area is needed. In this project, the MQ3 Sensor and Arduino UNO are used to create and construct an alcohol detection system with engine locking for automobiles. The technology will continuously check the alcohol detection sensor's concentration level and shut off the vehicle's engine if it rises above a certain level. The concept offers a practical way to reduce accidents caused by intoxicated driving.

articleTitle: An IOT Based Multifunctional Hearing and Medical Assistive System for Elderly
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: IoT (Internet of Things) technology can be applied to healthcare systems for the elderly population, enabling the monitoring and management of their health remotely. This paper presents an IoT-based health monitoring system for the elderly that utilizes sensors to collect vital signs and sends data to a central server for analysis and reporting. The proposed system aims to provide continuous, real-time monitoring of elderly patients and timely intervention when necessary. Our aim is to design a smart hearing aid which takes care of the complexity of the technology and eases it for old people. In this project, we sought to discover a means of assisting the elderly by automating some of their routine tasks and facilitating their interaction with technology. Our suggested methodology has demonstrated how this can be accomplished and put into practice using an Arduino Uno and AI assistant. This project will be very useful for the people who are technologically backward as well as physically disabled people. Hearing aids can help the persons with the loss in sensorineural.

articleTitle: Smart Biomedical Assisted System for Alzheimer Patient
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: In the last decades the health care developments highly rise the level of ages of world population. This improvement was accompanied by increasing the diseases related with elder like Dementia, which Alzheimer's disease represent the most common form. The present study aims to design and implementation a medical system for improving the life of Alzheimer's disease persons and ease the burden of their caregivers. A Smart Biomedical Assistance is an electronic device that provide around the clock monitoring the stability state of the Alzheimer's patient, showing their location on the map, automatically reminders for medication times, and a call button for an emergency case that the patient may pass through during the day. The device designed with two units one worn by the patient while the other is an internet of things technology (IOT) platform application used by the caregiver. The wearable unit was implemented by using a motion processing unit sensor, global positioning sensor module (GPS), heart rate sensor with microcontrollers and LCD display. This unit is supported by an (IOT) platform for communication with the patient from anywhere by the caregiver.

articleTitle: A Research on Emotion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Medical fields rely heavily on signal processing for tasks like audio signal processing from patients, monitoring vital signs, and image analysis (such as MRI or CT scans). When used in the context of your work, SER can be helpful for keeping an eye on patients' emotional states. Comprehending the emotional condition of a patient can be crucial in delivering suitable care and assistance, particularly in domains such as mental health. Signal processing is used in radio transmission and telecommunications to improve overall communication, lower interference, and improve the quality of audio signals. This can directly affect how clear communication is, which makes it crucial for things like mobile phones and radio broadcasts, among other things. Like in many other domains, machine learning is crucial to SER research. Pitch, tone, and speech patterns are examples of emotional cues that can be identified by machine learning models that have been trained to analyze audio signals. Real-time applications of these models can be used to interpret and classify speech-expressed emotions. The goal of the developing field of speech recognition and emotion extraction from speech signals is called SER. As you pointed out, humans can infer emotions from voice modulation intuitively, and ongoing research attempts to enable machines to do the same. Numerous industries, including customer service, healthcare, and even personalized AI systems, may benefit from this technology. For SER to function, realtime audio visualization is essential. It entails converting audio data into visual representations that are useful for speech analysis of emotional cues. Spectrophotomograms and other graphical depictions of audio characteristics that machine learning models can use to categorize emotions may be included in these visualizations. The potential applications in automotive systems are also highlighted in this work. SER has the potential to enhance user experience, safety, and customer interactions. It might, for instance, aid autonomous vehicles in comprehending the emotional state of their passengers or allow call center agents to better address the emotional needs of a caller. In conclusion, signal processing, machine learning, and SER combined to interpret and react to human emotions from audio signals could have a big impact on a lot of different areas, like automotive systems and healthcare. More responsive and sympathetic interactions between machines and people may result from this technology.

articleTitle: Asset Tracking and Monitoring Using RFID Technology for Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Design of a Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag and compatible reader for the design. Each RFID tag having a unique code is transferred from Tx pin to the reader providing all the details regarding the assets that needs to be tracked and monitored throughout. The process involves electromagnetic induction and tag is battery less which is powered by the reader when brought in certain range. The details regarding the assets are available in an Android application and can be modified when required. The details are stored in a Cloud and accessed whenever necessary. The assets that are being monitored are given with asset name, id, location, and also images are added. The design includes a handheld RFID reader and 125KHz RFID tag. These have many applications in many industries, tolls, hospitals…. etc.

articleTitle: Dual Security-Check Turnstile Using ANPR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: A dual security check turnstile using ANPR (Automatic Number Plate Recognition) technology is a security system that integrates a turnstile with a camera that captures the license plate of the vehicle entering or exiting the premises. This technology can provide enhanced security features, such as access control, monitoring, and data collection. The system works by cross-referencing the captured license plate information with a database of authorized vehicles, allowing or denying entry as necessary. This approach offers several benefits, including increased security, reduced human error, and improved efficiency in managing access to a facility. The use of ANPR technology in turnstiles is gaining popularity in various sectors, including transportation, parking, and security, due to its high accuracy, ease of use, and cost-effectiveness. In case a fraud car is detected by the ANPR technology, an additional task for OTP (One-Time Password) generation can be added to the dual security check turnstile system. This task can be activated automatically when the ANPR system identifies a license plate number that is not recognized or has been flagged as fraudulent in the system's database. When this occurs, the system can prompt the driver to provide additional identification details or to enter a one-time password (OTP) that has been sent to their mobile device. This OTP can serve as an additional layer of security to ensure that only authorized individuals can access the premises. The OTP can be generated using various methods, including SMS, email, or through a mobile application. By incorporating this additional security measure, the dual security check turnstile using ANPR technology can provide enhanced security and reduce the risk of unauthorized access by fraudulent vehicles.

articleTitle: Real Time Autonomous Vehicle Simulation Model for Lane, Obstacle Detection, Zebra Crossing and Traffic Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Self driving cars commonly known as Autonomous cars. ADAS which stands for Advanced driver assistance system is the most prevailing technologies which uses sensors in the car like radar and cameras to perceive the world around it. Autonomous cars mainly rely on the sensors, processors and software technologies in order to develop the model. In this paper we developed an autonomous car prototype which is capable of driving to maintain lanes, detect objects and recognize zebra crossing and traffic signals. The prototype primarily contains Raspberry pi, USB camera, ultrasonic sensor and driver module. The objectives are achieved by using computer vision techniques, openCV and image processing techniques. The algorithms used in this paper involve feature classification using contour detection, threshold optimization, sobel algorithms, color detection, gaussian filter and edge detection programmed in Python. The proposed system is cheap and can aid future scope for self-driving cars.

articleTitle: Review on Off-Road e-Skateboard and it's Status in Indian Market
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Design Innovation for 3 Cs Compute Communicate Control (ICDI3C)
abstract: Considering the limitations of urban roads and the discomfort of public transportation, e-skateboards emerge as a convenient and efficient alternative for short-distance travel, mitigating the challenges associated with traditional commuting methods. In this paper, we delve into an in-depth review of the off-road electric skateboard market in India, examining its status in laboratories and market ready products. We conducted a comprehensive market study on e-skateboards in India to identify their drawbacks, focusing on the difficulties associated with short commutes, such as traffic congestion, stress, and financial burdens. Moreover, we explore design considerations, specifically examining the mechanical aspects of e-skateboards.
